schema:
CREATE TABLE "Members" ("member_id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, "member_name" TEXT(255));

CREATE TABLE "Subscriptions" ("sub_id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, "member_id" INTEGER, "tier_code" TEXT(255), FOREIGN KEY ("member_id") REFERENCES "Members" ("member_id"));
correct_query: SELECT member_id, member_name FROM Members WHERE member_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM Subscriptions WHERE tier_code = 'BASIC') AND member_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM Subscriptions WHERE tier_code = 'PRO') AND NOT member_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM Subscriptions WHERE tier_code = 'TRIAL') ORDER BY member_id

expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.description: Truncates NOT IN subquery to a single scalar row (LIMIT 1), checking only the first returned exclusion row instead of the full exclusion set
expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.query: SELECT member_id, member_name FROM Members WHERE member_id IN (SELECT a.member_id FROM (SELECT member_id FROM Subscriptions WHERE tier_code = 'BASIC') AS a INNER JOIN (SELECT member_id FROM Subscriptions WHERE tier_code = 'PRO') AS b ON a.member_id = b.member_id WHERE NOT a.member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM Subscriptions WHERE tier_code = 'TRIAL' LIMIT 1)) ORDER BY member_id
